name: @iflow-mcp/jinjos-vibe-mcp

tools.name: repo_analysis
tools.description: Perform comprehensive analysis of a project's tech stack, AI configurations, and rule coverage

projectPath.description: Path to the project root directory to analyze

tools.name: init_rules
tools.description: Initialize the vibe system in a project, creating the vibe/ directory and platform configurations

projectPath.description: Path to the project root directory where vibe system should be initialized

platforms.description: Comma-separated list of platforms to configure (cursor,claude,copilot,gemini) or "auto" for all

full.description: Perform full setup including removal of original rule files

tools.name: sync_rules
tools.description: Sync rules from platform directories (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to the unified vibe/ directory

projectPath.description: Path to the project root directory where sync should be performed

full.description: Move rules and delete original files after sync

platforms.description: Comma-separated list of platforms to sync (cursor,copilot,claude) or "auto" for all

dryRun.description: Show what would be synced without making changes

tools.name: vibe_status
tools.description: Get comprehensive status of the vibe system including platform configurations, rule analysis, and performance metrics

projectPath.description: Path to the project root directory to check status for

verbose.description: Include detailed analysis and performance metrics
